i2c.note: A0 引脚三态 + 默认（§7.3.2 Table 2/Table 3）；MVP 不建模总线地址
i2c.pointer_register: 8 位指针寄存器，P1P0 选寄存器、上电 00（§7.5.1 Table 4）；MVP 断言不覆盖指针本身，与 TMP102 IR 同口径

registers.name: TEMP
registers.desc: Twelve-bit read-only register at bits15:4, bits3:0 zero. Effective conversion resolution selected by R1:R0=9/10/11/12bits; at POR default9bits, unneeded result LSBs zero until higher resolution selected. Result0 before first conversion completes.

fields.name: T
fields.desc: Full twelve-bit register format; R1:R0 selects effective ADC resolution and zeros unused LSBs.

fields.name: UNUSED
fields.desc: Low four bits always zero in the twelve-bit temperature register format; bits6:4 belong to conversion data.
fields.tier_evidence: Table7 p.16 explicitly shows bits3:0 zero; effective resolution unused LSBs from §7.3.1 p.9.

registers.name: CONFIG
registers.desc: 8 位配置寄存器（§7.5.3 Table 8）。手册两句合读：内部位上电全 0，但『The OS/ALERT bit reads as 1 after power-up or reset value』→ 总线读回 0x80。与 TMP102 的关键差异：本芯片 R1/R0 可写（9~12 位用户可选），TMP102 的 R1/R0 是只读 11

fields.name: OS
fields.desc: Write1 triggers one-shot only when SD1. Read reports comparator state with POL inversion; not an invariant1 and not a conversion-busy bit.

fields.name: F1
fields.desc: 故障队列 00:1 01:2 10:4 11:6 次连续故障（Table 9）

fields.name: POL
fields.desc: ALERT 极性 0:低有效 1:高有效

fields.name: TM
fields.desc: 0:比较器模式 1:中断模式（TMP101 才有中断态行为，TMP100 无 ALERT 引脚）

registers.name: TLOW
registers.desc: 12-bit threshold storage at all converter resolutions; TMP100.pdf p.18 Tables 11-14 and final paragraph.

fields.name: L
fields.desc: 12-bit threshold; independent of ADC conversion resolution

fields.name: UNUSED
fields.desc: Unused low four bits, fixed zero in threshold format
fields.tier_evidence: TMP100.pdf p.18 Tables 12 and 14 show lower nibble zero

registers.name: THIGH
registers.desc: 12-bit threshold storage at all converter resolutions; TMP100.pdf p.18 Tables 11-14 and final paragraph.

fields.name: H
fields.desc: 12-bit threshold; independent of ADC conversion resolution

fields.name: UNUSED
fields.desc: Unused low four bits, fixed zero in threshold format
fields.tier_evidence: TMP100.pdf p.18 Tables 12 and 14 show lower nibble zero
